design.subtitle: Layout, colour, light or dark, the cover and the card’s language. Changes save as you pick them.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.desc: No cover; name and company first

design.autoHint: The card follows each visitor’s phone: light by day, dark if their phone is dark.

brand.title: Show the workspace logo and name
brand.hint: Beside the company on the card, from the workspace settings.

nfc.title: Linked chips
nfc.subtitle: Chips linked to this card. Tapping one opens the card.
nfc.empty: No chips are linked to this card yet.
nfc.explain: Tapping a linked chip on a phone opens this card straight away.

settings.title: Card address
settings.subtitle: The card’s address and who can see it.
settings.slugHint: Must be unique. Allowed characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
settings.dangerZone: Deleting removes the card, its links and sections. Chips linked to it become unassigned.
settings.publishedHint: Anyone with the link or a chip can open it.
settings.draftHint: Only you and your team can see it.
settings.confirmPrompt: To confirm, type the card address:

share.title: Share & QR
share.subtitle: Anyone can scan this to open the card — no NFC needed.

upload.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MB, or drop a file here.

errors.slugMismatch: Please enter the correct card slug to confirm deletion.

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.empty: No activity yet. Numbers appear here once people open this card's link.

identity.title: Let's start with your name
identity.subtitle: This is what people see first when they open your card.

channels.title: How should people reach you?
channels.subtitle: Fill in what you use. Leave the rest empty — you can add more later.
channels.hint: Anything you fill in becomes a one-tap button on your card.

look.title: Pick a style
look.subtitle: You can change this any time, and there are more in the Templates tab.

nfcProgram.title: Program a tag from this phone
nfcProgram.idle: Tap the button, then hold a blank NFC tag against your phone. The tag is written and linked to this card automatically.
nfcProgram.holdTag: Hold the tag against your phone…
nfcProgram.writing: Writing the link to the tag…
nfcProgram.linking: Linking the tag to this card…
nfcProgram.verifying: Written and linked. Now lift the tag away and tap it once more, so the link on it can be checked.
nfcProgram.lockHint: Nobody can then change or wipe the link on it, you included. This can't be undone.
nfcProgram.done_verified: Done and checked. Tapping this tag now opens this card.
nfcProgram.done_locked: Done, checked and locked. Tapping this tag now opens this card, and its link can't be changed.
nfcProgram.done_unchecked: Done. The tag is linked to this card, but it wasn't checked; tap it once to be sure it opens.
nfcProgram.unsupported: Your browser cannot write NFC tags. This works in Chrome on Android; iPhone does not give NFC to any browser, so use the mobile app or a pre-encoded tag.
nfcProgram.insecure: NFC writing needs a secure (HTTPS) connection. Open this page over HTTPS and try again.

errors.read: Could not read the tag. Move it away and try again.
errors.register: The tag was written but could not be registered.
errors.otherTag: That was a different tag. Program this one from the start, or tap the tag you just wrote.
errors.verify: The tag didn't keep the link. Hold it still and program it again, or try another tag.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Apply a finished look. Your content stays; the preview updates as you choose.

variants.title: Profiles on one link
variants.subtitle: Your card keeps one public link. Each profile can change the details, look, links and sections, and shows to people with a private key or passcode, on a schedule, or when you switch it on. When none applies, the default profile shows.
variants.added: Profile added as a copy of your default.
variants.deleteConfirm: Its private link and content will stop working. This cannot be undone.
variants.conflictMultiple: {{count}} profiles are switched on at once, so only “{{name}}” shows.
variants.conflictOverlap: “{{a}}” and “{{b}}” have overlapping schedules, so “{{a}}” shows.

default.title: Default profile
default.hint: Shows when no other profile applies. Edit it in the Content and Design tabs.

variants.emptyBody: Add a profile to show a different version of your card to specific people, at a specific time, or for an occasion.
variants.manualHint: For an event or an occasion
variants.contentToggle: Links and sections for this profile
